reply: Thank you for explaining that an $80.00 gift card was declined every time it was used, and that the replacement card and email you were told about never arrived. We understand how long you have waited. Your complaint has been logged for review by the prepaid card team, including your request for the balance instead of a replacement. Please keep the card, the purchase receipt and your emails to the support address. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card account was closed without a clear reason and that the file sent in response to your dispute appeared to relate to a different account. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please ask in writing for the account statements showing where and when your cards were used, and keep copies of the responses you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about several hard inquiries on your credit reports that you did not authorize. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each inquiry with the credit reporting companies that show it, and if you believe this is identity theft, report it through the federal identity theft website. Keep copies of every dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that new transactions appeared on a credit account you could no longer access after your main account was closed for fraud. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including the disputed transactions, closing the account and the credit balance. To stop your scheduled payments, tell the company and your bank in writing that you are cancelling them. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told several times to wait for the $250.00 promotional credit, and then told after the offer ended that your flights did not qualify. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including what you were told by phone. Please keep the offer details from the airline website and the dates of your calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card details were stolen on a fraudulent website, that one charge was credited but $970.00 was not, and that your letter about errors in the investigation report has had no reply. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep copies of your letter, your original rental agreement and the report. Your cardholder agreement explains your rights for unauthorized charges. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you cannot reset your password or log in, even after verifying your identity by phone, and so cannot pay or close your account. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account access team. Please keep a note of the dates of your calls, and ask in writing for another way to make payments and request closure while access is restored. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $1,000.00 to a company you now believe is a scam, that you were threatened after disputing it, and that the credit was reversed. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the messages, including the threats, and consider reporting them to local police. Do not share personal details with the merchant. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for a temporary lower payment while on medical leave and that your requests were refused. We are sorry you are facing health problems and financial pressure at the same time. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including hardship options. Please keep a note of when you made each request, and ask in writing what hardship programs exist for your account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an address that is not yours was reported to a credit bureau more than once, even after you were told it had been fixed. We understand your concern that your account may still be linked to someone else. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please also dispute the address directly with the credit bureau and keep the earlier response letter. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a payment went to the wrong card account by mistake four months ago and has still not been returned, despite many calls and a letter. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your bank statement showing the payment, the letter you sent and a note of each call, and ask for written confirmation of where the money is now. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your purchases kept being declined, that a certificate went to the wrong account, and that you were passed between many departments without a fix. We understand how frustrating this has been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep the decline dates, the fraud alerts you received and the account emails, and ask for a single point of contact. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector has not provided documents to support an account on your credit report, despite your requests. We understand why you want it verified. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. You can ask the collector for the validation information it must give you, and dispute the item with the credit reporting companies. Keep copies of your requests. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account on your credit report shows a past due balance of $1,600.00 and a late payment that you believe are incorrect. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a dispute to each credit reporting company showing this account, explain what is wrong and why, and include copies of any statements or payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a collection notice and have asked the collector to validate the debt and pause collection. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Collectors must give you certain information about the debt, so keep a copy of your validation request and the date you sent it. If the debt is reported, you can ask that it be shown as disputed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that someone changed your profile details and opened an account in your name before you could regain control. We understand your concern about how this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the security team. Please keep the text alert and a note of your calls, review your credit reports for other new accounts, and consider a security freeze. Never share codes with callers you cannot verify. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your dispute letter about inaccurate items has not received a response after 30 days. We understand how frustrating it is to wait. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Disputes are usually investigated within 30 days, or up to 45 days in some cases, so please keep proof of the date your letter was received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about accounts on your credit report that you did not open. We understand how this affects your credit history. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each account with the credit reporting companies that list it, and if this is identity theft, report it through the federal identity theft website so you can include the report with your disputes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for writing about the reinvestigation of items you have disputed on your credit file. We understand you expect a timely and thorough review. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each item you dispute, explain what is inaccurate, and include copies of any documents that support your dispute. If you disagree with the outcome, you can ask for a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that accounts you disputed were reported as verified, but you have not received the documents or the method used to verify them. We understand why you want to know how they were confirmed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please ask in writing for a description of how each account was verified, and keep copies of every request and result. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you have not received a response to your dispute letter after more than 30 days, and about your concern over data breaches. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep proof of when your letter was received. Investigations generally take 30 days, sometimes up to 45. You may also want to place a security freeze because of the breaches. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that several accounts on your credit report show late payments that you believe are not correct. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each account and the month shown as late, and gather any payment confirmations from those months. Checking your report for other common errors, such as wrong account details, will also help the review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that accounts and inquiries from identity theft appear on your credit report, and that you have reported the theft to the Federal Trade Commission. We understand the stress this causes. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send your Identity Theft Report with a list of the items to block, and keep checking your reports to confirm they are removed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for writing about information on your credit file that you say resulted from fraud and has not been removed. We understand your frustration that it is still there. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send your dispute again with your fraud report and a clear list of each item, and keep copies. If you disagree with the result, you can ask for a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that accounts on your credit report are not yours and that your personal information appears in a data breach. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each account with the credit reporting companies and report the identity theft through the federal identity theft website, then keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for writing about accounts and inquiries on your credit file that you want reinvestigated. We understand you expect a timely review. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain for each item why it is inaccurate and include any documents that support your dispute. If you disagree with the result of the investigation, you can ask for a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that accounts you did not open remain on your credit reports after your disputes, and that your information was exposed in data breaches. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. If this is identity theft, please report it through the federal identity theft website and send the report with your disputes, and close any affected accounts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your credit report contains inaccurate information and that you have records to support your dispute. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send copies of your bank statements, receipts and creditor letters with your dispute. If the company that supplied the information finds it was wrong, it must tell every credit reporting company it reported to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concerns about how your information is reported and that some accounts are not related to your own transactions. We understand your concern for your privacy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the specific accounts you do not recognize and dispute them with each credit reporting company. You can ask for a reinvestigation if you disagree with the result. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want an account removed unless evidence is provided to show it is accurate. We understand your frustration with the response so far. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify the account in your dispute, explain what is inaccurate, and ask for a description of how it was verified. Keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
